name: Spotify Highest Quality
author: dnlsndr
summary: Raises Spotify's DJ SDK quality argument to its highest level.
description:
Hooks the Spotify DJ SDK's DJDownload_add_track and raises the DJAudioQuality argument to 8 when it is lower. 8 is the highest level the deck's Spotify integration exposes (the SDK's own '8 (Highest quality)' entry).

This is not Spotify Lossless/FLAC. The deck's hardware eSDK exposes Hifi24 only as track metadata; its playback bitrate API has no lossless setting. The mod logs the old and new quality on each track it changes.
